Pakistan Cricket Team Faces Changes and Defeat Against West Indies

Pakistan's cricket team underwent changes, with Abdullah Shafique and Saud Shakeel returning for the test match against the West Indies. Despite these adjustments and the return of captain Babar Azam, the team suffered a 90-run defeat. The loss has impacted Pakistan's standing in the WTC 2025-27 points table, with Australia currently at the top. Captain Babar Azam attributed the "shameful defeat" to unusual reasons.
